Record Class GmailMessageDetails

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.gmail.GmailMessageDetails
Record Components:
messageId - The unique Gmail message identifier.
threadId - The parent thread ID.
date - The date string from the message headers.
from - The sender email address or formatted identity.
to - The recipient email addresses.
cc - The carbon copy recipients (if present).
bcc - The blind carbon copy recipients (if present).
subject - The email subject.
snippet - The snippet preview.
bodyPlain - The decoded plain text content.
bodyHtml - The decoded or sanitized HTML content.
hasAttachments - Whether file attachments exist.
attachments - List of attachments with metadata and retrieval IDs.
labels - List of Gmail system or user labels applied to the message.
public record GmailMessageDetails(String messageId, String threadId, String date, String from, String to, String cc, String bcc, String subject, String snippet, String bodyPlain, String bodyHtml, boolean hasAttachments, List<GmailAttachmentInfo> attachments, List<String> labels) extends Record
Detailed representation of an email message including full RFC 822 headers, decoded text and HTML bodies, and attachment descriptors.

anahata
